description: Keyword search over Development Radio episodes: titles, topics, chapter titles, takeaways, summaries, cited source titles and the full timed transcripts. Up to six keywords of three or more characters are used; a keyword matches at the start of a word. Episodes are ranked by how many keywords they contain, and when any episode contains more than half of them, episodes containing half or fewer are left out. Each result comes with its id, title, date, page URL, the best-matching passage (with a timestamp when it comes from the transcript) and the URLs of the primary sources the episode cites. Use this when you need a sourced account of a security incident, CVE, outage, AI or software-development news item, or an engineering practice such as lock expiry, replica lag, queue fairness or content security policy. The show's hosts are AI-generated voices.

lane.description: Only episodes in this lane of the show.

limit.description: Maximum number of episodes to return.

query.description: Keywords, for example "nginx http2 rce" or "redis lock expiry".
